svg.desc: About. Full-stack engineer, cloud underneath. The short version, as a shell session. whoami — Abdulla Alasmawi, software engineer in Manama, Bahrain (UTC+3) — cat about.txt — I work across the stack, from the data model and API to the interface and the deployment. At the AWS Cloud Innovation Center I built a serverless monitoring platform for the Ministry of Interior Police K9 Unit. At the Bahrain Shura Council I built Bayyan, a bilingual obligations register piloted across four teams, and moved a production database from Amazon RDS to on-premises servers with no data lost. — cat profile.json — degree: B.Sc. Computer Science, cloud computing track; school: University of Bahrain; program: Full Stack Development, DevOps specialization; writes: Go, Rust, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Shell; speaks: Arabic, English; looking_for: a role on a product team
